family_reports.body: The family court system has removed a full time father and allows the mother to alienate and abuse both the children and father unlawfully. I once trusted in the judicial system until I got involved and now I truly understand the abuse of authority with no accountability. Treason
Perpetually in my family and home

This magistrate has failed due process, failed to uphold constitutional rights, failed to uphold judicial code of conduct. Treason
